notes: Public option is the Værnesekspressen airport coach: about 30 min to the city centre and up to 4 departures per hour per the official pages. The adult single fare is not printed on the official pages: 199 NOK is taken from an Airmundo guide (third-party); other guides range 130-219 NOK and say online purchase is cheaper. Local AtB zone A adult single 50 NOK and 24-hour 150 NOK come from the official AtB pages (24-hour from 9 Jun 2026). A cheaper AtB bus option is not verified. Taxi and ride-hailing not researched (search budget exhausted).

taxi.basis: Estimate for a daytime metered ride of about 8 km: 45 DKK start plus 14 DKK per km (gobytaxi.com, labelled 2026). Calculator sites give 127-149 DKK (2023 data). Not an official tariff.

notes: Metro M2 takes about 13 min per a 2026 guide. The 40 DKK airport fare is for a zone 1-4 single (Routesnorth, Nomadotravel); other sources give 36 DKK (3 zones, Visit Copenhagen, undated) and 30 DKK (2026 guide). Local single 24 DKK is from Nomadotravel (two zones); a 2026 guide gives 30 DKK. The 24-hour figure is the visitor City Pass (from about 100 DKK, zones 1-4 incl. airport), not a standard 24-hour ticket price. cph.dk and DOT/Movia pages could not be read, so no operator-confirmed figure. Metro frequency and hours not verified. Uber airport taxi page found; Bolt not verified.

taxi.basis: Fixed-rate quotes: 740 SEK standard (ACM 2024 travel page); 2026-dated guides 545-745 SEK; Trippus ceiling 700-750 SEK. Minutes is the midpoint of the 35-50 min range from a guide. Not an official tariff.

notes: Local tickets are SL 2025 official prices (75-min single 43 SEK; 24-hour 180 SEK, from 8 Jan 2025). No 2026 SL figure was confirmed (sl.se could not be read). Arlanda Express 340 SEK one-way is from the official page. The cheaper SL commuter train and Flygbussarna buses to Arlanda exist but their fares were not verified. Skavsta (NYO) and Bromma (BMA) not researched (search budget exhausted). Uber and Bolt named as operators in a Stockholm tourism guide.

taxi.basis: Quoted Landvetter-to-centre taxi 420-550 SEK across guides (Airmundo about 500; fixed-fare cabs 435-500; gu.se about 550). 500 SEK used. Not an official tariff; some quotes are undated or from event pages.

notes: Local single 38 SEK (one zone, adult) from 9 Jun 2026 per the Vasttrafik price-change release. The 125 SEK day ticket is a tourism-site starting price; Vasttrafik's own day-ticket figure was not confirmed. Flygbussarna (Vy) fare for 2026 not confirmed: a May 2025 guide gives 119-139 SEK (139 used, top of range); Rome2Rio gives 130-150. Swedavia gives about 20 min. Taxi figures are quotes only. Ride-hailing not verified for Gothenburg.

taxi.basis: Taksi Helsinki fixed fare to central postcodes 00100-00180 and 00220 for 1-4 passengers (page undated). Menevä listing 42 EUR; a 2023 guide 35 EUR. Not an official tariff.

notes: hsl.fi returned HTTP 403 to direct fetch, so the 2026 figures come from search summaries of HSL pages: single ABC 4.50 EUR (app, card or machine) and 4.80 EUR (contactless). The 12.80 EUR one-day ABC figure is mapped from a Finnish 2026 price sheet (sttinfo.fi) and should be checked in the HSL app. A 9 EUR day pass on subger.com was disregarded as unreliable. The airport train takes about 30 min; its frequency and hours were not verified. Uber presence is inferred from Uber's HEL airport taxi page only.

taxi.basis: Typical official taxi to the city centre per the cestee.com Tallinn airport guide (third-party; not an official tariff).

notes: Bus 2 per the official airport page: 2 EUR single QR ticket (valid 60 min); journey time, frequency and hours are not on that page. cestee.com describes tram lines 2 and 4 instead (about 15 min to the centre, every 5-7 min combined, last tram 00:15, first 05:23 weekdays), and 2026 tram service is conflicting (the airport page says trams return 1 Aug 2026; a travel guide says they are off for construction). The 5.50 EUR 24-hour pass is from a Sep 2025 Baltic Guide article; transport.tallinn.ee could not be read. Tallinn residents ride free. Ride-hailing not verified. A 3 EUR 24-hour figure on one university page conflicts and was disregarded.
